items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Which were the guys then that played? The Trombar. Trumpauer? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That played with the mixed band? ... [INTERVIEWER] But Trombar didn't go, did he? Trumpauer

ctx.x: -- boy what a hand. I never will forget that hand we got that night.
Which were the guys then that played? The Trombar. Trumpauer?
That played with the mixed band?
